title: Yellow Crispy Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A sweet and crispy one-pot Moroccan dish featuring applesauce and miso-marinated chicken, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the miso paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the applesauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Increase the heat to medium-high and cook, uncovered, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is crispy, about 5 minutes.
